events.description: Called when the user ticks or unticks a task; left out, the boxes are read-only.
events.name: onCompleteChange

events.description: Called when the user shows or hides the task list.
events.name: onExpandedChange

props.description: The card's title, for example "Set up your store".
props.name: title

props.description: Whether the task list is shown, for a controlled guide.
props.name: isExpanded

props.description: Whether the task list starts shown. Defaults to true until every task is done.
props.name: defaultExpanded

props.description: Writes the progress, for example "2 of 5 tasks done". Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's sentence.
props.name: progressLabel

props.description: The text shown once every task is done. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "All set".
props.name: completeLabel

props.description: The spoken name of the show/hide button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Show tasks" or "Hide tasks".
props.name: toggleLabel

props.description: The surface level of the card; `transparent` drops the background and shadow. Defaults to `default`.
props.name: variant

props.description:
Animation configuration for surface
- `"disable-all"`: Disable all animations including children
- `undefined`: Use default animations
props.name: animation

props.description:
When `true`, merges surface styling onto the single child element (Slot pattern).
The child must be one React element. Uses `Slot.View` internally.
props.name: asChild

props.description:
Background layer rendered behind the surface content.
- `undefined` (default): renders `Surface.Background` for non-transparent
  variants when the active library theme registers default background
  content (e.g. `glass`); otherwise no layer
- custom node: replaces the default layer entirely (wrap content in
  `Surface.Background` to keep the absolute-fill and clipping)
- `null`: removes the background layer

Not injected when `asChild` is `true` — the Slot pattern requires a
single child; render `Surface.Background` inside your child instead.
props.name: background

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
